correctness.rationale: Derived exact selected inverse-sum expectation using Xi=sigma_i Yi iid Gamma(n,1), S=X1+X2 independent of T=X1/S ~ Beta(n,n), selection T>r/(1+r) for r=sigma1/sigma2. Integrating reciprocal Xi gives E[1/(sigma_J Y_J)]=1/(n-1)-x(r)^(n-1)/[(n-1)² B(n,n-1)], x=r/(1+r)². Entropy-risk subtraction yields Delta=that expectation-log(n/(n-1)). At r=1 it is strictly negative by central-binomial lower bound; as max(r,1/r)→∞ it tends to the positive constant 1/(n-1)-log(n/(n-1)). Since x decreases strictly with max(r,1/r)≥1, Delta increases strictly and has one crossing q_n∈(0,1/4), rho_n=(1+sqrt(1-4q_n))/(1-sqrt(1-4q_n)). Independently compared incomplete-beta integrals against the formula at n=2,5,8,11 and several hazard ratios; n=2 rho=4.2843765164, n=5 rho=2.6791419805, n=8 rho=2.2878314577. No universal admissibility follows.
